title: Chaos Erupts At Walmart When Entitled Women Think Their Above The Law
description:
On October 29th, 2024, police responded to a call at Walmart about a woman refusing to leave the premises. Prior to that, an officer had conducted a traffic stop after spotting a 15-year-old behind the wheel with an adult woman in the passenger seat, parked in front of the store. While officers were arresting the woman refusing to leave, the other woman intervened. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
